purpose: Teach: 大卒/常駐/還流/短絡/受話器/取り引き/改名/おもに

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、大卒以外の人材登用も検討しろ
lines.en: Start considering hiring candidates without a university degree.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Clipped delivery on the verb. No hesitation—this is a decision being handed down. Posture upright, eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の本社に営業担当を常駐させております
lines.en: Understood. We currently have a permanent sales representative stationed at our major client's headquarters.
lines.style: Respectful, procedural tone. Slight formality in posture. Delivering information with precision, not elaboration. Steady eye contact, composed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外利益の還流計画を立てろ
lines.en: Create a plan for repatriating overseas profits.
lines.style: Sharp, decisive. The opening syllable lands with weight. Brief, expecting no questions. Authoritative posture unchanged—this is instruction, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。短絡的な判断は避けるようにしております
lines.en: Understood. We make sure to avoid hasty judgment calls in all our decisions.
lines.style: Calm, reassuring undertone. Slightly slower pacing to show deliberation. Nodding subtly as he speaks—affirming he understands the reasoning behind the directive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、固定電話の受話器も更新しろ
lines.en: We also need to update the landline handsets in our office.
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact. Minor task but stated with same authority as the larger ones. Quick, efficient delivery. Practical rather than emphatic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様との取り引きを継続いたします
lines.en: Understood. We'll continue to maintain our relationships with our valued clients.
lines.style: Polite acknowledgment, steady tempo. Slightly warmer than previous responses—this touches on something concrete he can commit to. Genuine, not just dutiful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ブランドを改名する案は慎重に検討しろ
lines.en: Think carefully and deliberately about any proposal to rebrand the company.
lines.style: Measured, almost cautionary. Weight on 'carefully'—this is a sensitive decision. Slower pace on the last clause. Eyes steady, communicating the seriousness of the instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社はおもに国内市場で展開しております
lines.en: Understood. Our primary focus remains the domestic market.
lines.style: Final statement, slightly closing in tone. Calm and grounded. Brief pause before speaking, showing this brings the conversation to resolution. Respectful but settled.
